component.name: OneDriveGUI
component.summary: A simple GUI for Linux OneDrive Client with multi-account support

description.p: OneDriveGUI is a simple graphical management interface for the Linux OneDrive client (abraunegg/onedrive), supporting multiple accounts, real-time sync monitoring, and configuration management.

This Flatpak wrapper fetches the self-contained Linux package built by helloshu/auto-builds at install time via extra-data, including a bundled Python 3.12 + PySide6 runtime and fallback abraunegg/onedrive v2.5.12 CLI.
